item.title: Victgoal Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Head Injury; Violate Mandatory Standard for Bicycle Helmets
item.company: Sold At: Authorized Triumph Motorcycle Dealers from January 2025 through July 2026 for between $10,000 and $15,000.
item.brand: Sold At: Authorized Triumph Motorcycle Dealers from January 2025 through July 2026 for between $10,000 and $15,000.
item.product: 2025 and 2026 Triumph TF450 models Closed Course Competition Motorcycles
item.summary: This recall involves Victgoal-branded bicycle helmets. The red helmets were sold in size small (S), fitting a head circumference of about 19.68 to 21.25 inches. The helmets have red padding, black straps with a silver reflective pattern in the center, a black and red buckle and a black fit-adjusting knob at the back. Only helmets manufactured in November 2025 are included in this recall. "Model HT-006," "Production: 2025/11" and "Ref/Lot# 2025A1101" are printed on a label on the inside of the helmet. "Victgoal" is printed on the product packing bag.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: 2025 and 2026 Triumph TF450 models Closed Course Competition Motorcycles.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using 2025 and 2026 Triumph TF450 models Closed Course Competition Motorcycles immediately and contact Triumph Motorcycles for a free repair. Consumers can check if their VIN is included in this recall at https://www.triumphmotorcycles.com/owners/recalls. Consumers with recalled motorcycles should contact their local authorized Triumph Motorcycle dealer who will inspect the engine and replace the cylinder head free of charge.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
